Bitcoin Investors Buy Nearly $1B in BTC ETFs as Bull Market Returns

The Bitcoin bulls are back — if ETF flows are to be believed.  U.S. bitcoin exchange-traded funds received $999 million in new investment on Monday, according to Farside Investors data.  That’s the most in one day since October 6, when the funds received over $1.2 billion and the price of the leading cryptocurrency hit a […]
